newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL - Swedish June PPI seen rising 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Swedish June PPI seen rising 0.3 pct.

text.p: The Swedish producer price index (PPI) was expected to rise 0.3 percent in June from May, for an annual rise of 1.9 percent compared to June 1996, a poll of 13 analysts showed.
Forecasts ranged from a flat figure to a rise of 0.5 percent compared to the previous month.
Producer prices rose 0.7 percent in May for a year-on-year increase of 1.4 percent. In June 1996 PPI fell 0.3 percent for a yearly fall of 3.5 percent.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish the figure at 0800 GMT on July 25.

Analysts who participated in this survey were from: Aragon, Chase, Consensus, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, J P Morgan, Nomura, Nordbanken, Penser, S-E-Banken, Sparbanken and UBS.
